# Constellation Design

> Creative consultancy driven by curiosity, led by Qa'id Jacobs from Amsterdam. Specialising in UX Design, Creative Direction, Product Strategy, and Workshops.

Constellation Design partners with brands to create meaningful digital experiences rooted in research, storytelling, and craft. The studio brings a considered, process-led approach to every engagement — from early strategy through to final execution.

## Pages

- [About](https://constellation.design/about): Background on the consultancy and Qa'id Jacobs — designer, creative director, and strategist based in Amsterdam.
- [Services](https://constellation.design/services): UX Design, Creative Direction, Product Strategy, and Workshops — how the studio works and what it offers.
- [Work](https://constellation.design/work): Portfolio of selected case studies across design, creative direction, and strategy.
- [Contact](https://constellation.design/contact): Get in touch for collaborations, project enquiries, and workshop bookings.

## Case Studies

- [The Wild](https://constellation.design/work/the-wild): Visual exploration and promotional design for The Wild Pop-up Bookstore.
- [Amplifon](https://constellation.design/work/amplifon): Optimising the flows and dashboards used by audiologists to assess walk-in patients.
- [The Usual Hotel](https://constellation.design/work/the-usual-hotel): Establishing an experience that takes hotel guests from booking online to checking in.

## About the Studio

Constellation Design is led by Qa'id Jacobs, a designer and creative director with a background spanning UX, brand identity, and product strategy. The studio is based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

## Contact

For project enquiries: https://constellation.design/contact
